## Concepts and intuitions {.unnumbered}
The invention of mouse and touchscreen has changed how we interact with a computer.
With vocal command, we are approaching a new dimensions.

That being said, keyboard are here to last because it is excellent and efficient at some tasks.

Example one, typing on a keyboard is still more efficient than pressing letters on a or clicking with a mouse (if you disagree, I dare you write something longer than a sentence).

And for anyone who has discovered the ctrl + s (or cmd + s) to save a document has never returned to click file, scroll down etc.
Pressing space bar is still faster than hovering the most to find the pause button...I think that telling telling : Siri or Alexa or etc to pause the video.

Long story short, keyboard is very efficient and productive way to interact with a computer, the only downside is that you need to remember some shortcuts, but you only need a few, and you will remember them after a few uses so here is a short list

Universal:
- save ctrl + S
- copy ctrl + C
- paste ctrl + V notice it is just the letter next to c
- select all: ctrl + A

RStudio
- executing a line or code chunch ctrl + enter
- inserting a assignment ctr + XX
- toggling a comment ctrl + /
- Add one indent to the right ctrl + [ or right ctrl + ]

If you open, you will see a list of shortcuts, go to here and there.
You can define your own but careful not to override other useful one (for instance ctrl + s for xxx) so better not touch the conventional ones.
